strategy.thesis: Equity-free, batch-based accelerator turbocharging top founders across Greater Southeast Asia; current AW batches emphasize AI, Web3 and deep tech such as Manufacturing AI, Defense Tech, On-Chain Banking and PQC.

program.location: Taipei (8F-1, No. 88, Yanchang Rd., Xinyi Dist.)
program.eligibility: Founders at any stage (pre-revenue, seed, Series A, or profitable); no equity/fee taken

application.how_to_apply: Online application (~30 topics) twice a year via appworks.tw/accelerator

summary.en: AppWorks is the largest accelerator in Greater Southeast Asia. Founded 2010, it runs an equity-free, ~6-month batch program (20-30 startups per batch, twice a year) with a Demo Day and a 2,000+ founder alumni network. It also operates as a VC. Current cohorts emphasize AI and Web3.
summary.local: AppWorks(之初加速器)為大東南亞最大加速器,2010 年成立。提供不收股權、不收費的約六個月梯次計畫(每梯 20-30 隊、一年兩梯),有 Demo Day 與 2,000+ 創辦人校友網絡,同時經營創投,近期梯次聚焦 AI 與 Web3。

strategy.thesis: Three-month, mentorship-driven accelerator for seed/early-stage data-focused startups with potential to expand into international markets; part of the global SparkLabs Group network.

perks: Corporate partners (Google, Samsung Next, Deloitte, KPMG, Citi)
program.eligibility: Seed to early-stage startups aiming to enter international markets

application.how_to_apply: Apply on a rolling basis via JotForm linked on the program page; three interview rounds

summary.en: SparkLabs Taipei is the Taiwan arm of the global SparkLabs Group, launched in 2018. Its ~3-month, twice-yearly accelerator invests up to US$100K for up to 7% equity and has accelerated 60+ early-stage startups, with two exits (JustKitchen IPO, ParseMe acquisition).
summary.local: SparkLabs Taipei 為全球 SparkLabs Group 在台分支,2018 年來台。約三個月、一年兩梯的加速器計畫投資至多 10 萬美元、取得至多 7% 股權,已加速 60+ 早期新創,並有兩家成功出場(JustKitchen 上市、ParseMe 被併購)。

strategy.thesis: Government-backed three-stage accelerator (Create / Propel / Scale) helping Taiwanese startups with team formation, business-model validation and international (incl. SelectUSA) expansion across multiple deep-tech sectors.

program.eligibility: Taiwanese / Taiwan-connected startups; staged by readiness (Create/Propel/Scale)

application.how_to_apply: Apply to relevant batch via TAcc+ portal; contact support@taccplus.com

summary.en: TAcc+ (Taiwan Accelerator Plus) is a Taiwan government-backed accelerator established in 2019, organized under SMEA/MOEA and executed by ITRI. Its three-stage Create/Propel/Scale model supports startups across AI/IoT, biotech, cleantech, cybersecurity, healthcare and spacetech; secondary sources report 500+ startups coached and over NT$6 billion raised.
summary.local: TAcc+(臺灣加速器)為 2019 年成立的政府支持加速器,由中小及新創企業署(SMEA/MOEA)主導、工研院(ITRI)執行。以 Create/Propel/Scale 三階段協助 AI/IoT、生技、潔淨科技、資安、醫療、太空科技等多領域新創;二手資料指其已輔導 500+ 新創、募資逾新台幣 60 億元。

strategy.thesis: Equity-free accelerator run by the non-profit Epoch Foundation; its Startup Global Program connects selected international and Taiwanese startups with Taiwan's corporations, supply chains and investors as a platform to expand into Asia.

perks: Access to Taiwan supply chains and investors
program.eligibility: Early-stage international and Taiwanese startups (Startup Global Program)

application.how_to_apply: Apply to the annual Startup Global Program at garageplus.asia

summary.en: Garage+ is an equity-free accelerator operated by Taiwan's non-profit Epoch Foundation since 2008. Through its Startup Global Program it selects international and Taiwanese startups (e.g. 31 teams in 2024) and connects them with Taiwan's corporations, supply chains and investors; over 435 startups (216 international) had participated by 2022.
summary.local: Garage+ 由台灣非營利的智榮基金會(Epoch Foundation)自 2008 年起營運,完全不收股權。透過 Startup Global Program 選拔國際與台灣新創(如 2024 年選出 31 隊),媒合台灣企業、供應鏈與投資人;截至 2022 年已有 435+ 新創(含 216 國際團隊)參與。

strategy.thesis: Government-backed startup hub established by the National Science and Technology Council (formerly MOST) that hosts and coordinates multiple accelerator programs (IAPS, SparkLabs Taipei, BE, MOX, etc.) across AI, IoT, healthtech, fintech and cybersecurity, and connects Taiwanese startups to global markets.

perks: Hub for multiple accelerators (IAPS, SparkLabs, BE, MOX)
program.eligibility: Tech startups; routed into specific hosted accelerator programs

application.how_to_apply: Apply via taiwanarena.tech to a specific hosted accelerator program (e.g. IAPS)

summary.en: Taiwan Tech Arena (TTA) is a government startup hub founded in September 2018 under the Ministry of Science and Technology (now NSTC). It hosts and coordinates multiple accelerator programs (IAPS, SparkLabs Taipei, BE, MOX) across diverse sectors and helps Taiwanese deep-tech startups reach global markets; its IAPS program has accelerated over 500 startups.
summary.local: 臺灣科技新創基地(TTA)為 2018 年 9 月在科技部(現國科會 NSTC)下成立的政府新創基地,匯集並協調多個加速器計畫(IAPS、SparkLabs Taipei、BE、MOX)橫跨多領域,協助台灣深科技新創拓展國際;旗下 IAPS 已加速超過 500 家新創。

strategy.thesis: Government-run international startup campus and 'Potential Startup Selection' (潛力新創選拔) program by the SME and Startup Administration (SMEA/MOEA), supporting seed/early-stage startups across Deep Tech (Black Tech), Consumer Tech (White Tech) and Green Tech.

program.eligibility: Seed/early-stage startups within 5 years of establishment

summary.en: Taiwan Startup Terrace (Linkou) is a government-run international startup campus under SMEA/MOEA. Its Potential Startup Selection (Hi-Po Star) program certifies seed/early-stage startups across Deep, Consumer and Green Tech categories — its first cohort selected 16 from 238 applicants — and the campus has supported 114 teams (21 international).
summary.local: Taiwan Startup Terrace(林口新創園)為中小及新創企業署(SMEA/MOEA)營運的國際新創園區。旗下「潛力新創選拔(Hi-Po Star)」針對種子/早期新創,分黑科技(Deep)、白科技(Consumer)、綠科技(Green)三類,首屆自 238 家中選出 16 家;園區累計支持 114 隊(含 21 國際團隊)。

name.local: G Camp 國際創新創業訓練營

strategy.thesis: Government-guided (SME and Startup Administration / MOEA) international entrepreneurship training camp; 'G' stands for Global, Growing and Going, aiming to optimize Taiwanese startups' international business skills and link them to global markets.

investment.raw: NT$5,000,000 in resources for winning teams

program.eligibility: Taiwanese startups aiming to expand internationally

application.how_to_apply: Apply to the annual G Camp international entrepreneurship training camp

summary.en: G Camp (國際創新創業訓練營) is a government-guided international entrepreneurship accelerator/training camp under the SME and Startup Administration (MOEA). It provides intensive in-person training plus resources worth NT$5 million for winning teams, and has trained 55 domestic startups over three years with overseas trips to Austin, Fukuoka and Helsinki.
summary.local: G Camp(國際創新創業訓練營)為經濟部中小及新創企業署指導的國際創新創業加速/訓練營,提供密集實體培訓,獲選隊伍可獲價值新台幣 500 萬元資源,三年內培訓 55 家國內新創,並帶隊赴美國奧斯汀、日本福岡、芬蘭赫爾辛基等地參展交流。

sources.title: 2024 G Camp 國際創新創業訓練營
sources.supports: Government-guided (SMEA/MOEA); G = Global/Growing/Going; NT$5M resources; intensive training; 55 startups in 3 years
sources.quote: G Camp為經濟部中小及新創企業署指導及推動的國際創新創業訓練營 ... G of GCamp represents Global, Growing and Going ... 55 domestic startups training in 3 years ... resource support that values 5 million for winning teams

verification_notes: G Camp is a short, intensive (multi-day) government training camp rather than a multi-month cohort; included as a general accelerator program. The NT$5M figure refers to resources awarded to winning teams, not a cash investment. Founding ~2018 (3 years of operation reported around 2020-2021).

strategy.thesis: Taipei City Government (Department of Economic Development) startup platform offering free one-on-one advisory, mentoring and a 'Promising Startup Mentoring Plan' to help early teams across all sectors overcome growth bottlenecks.

program.eligibility: Aspiring and new entrepreneurs in Taipei across all sectors

application.how_to_apply: Book free advisory online or apply to the Promising Startup Mentoring Plan at startup.taipei

summary.en: Startup@Taipei (創業台北) is the Taipei City Government's general, sector-agnostic startup platform run by its Department of Economic Development. It provides free one-on-one advisory, business/legal/tax guidance and a 'Promising Startup Mentoring Plan' to help early-stage teams across all sectors, plus an official directory of Taipei accelerators and incubators.
summary.local: Startup@Taipei(創業台北)為臺北市政府產業發展局營運的通用型新創平台,提供免費一對一創業諮詢、商業計畫/登記/法稅輔導,以及「潛力新創輔導計畫」,協助各領域早期團隊突破成長瓶頸,並彙整臺北市加速器與育成中心名錄。

sources.supports: Taipei City Gov platform; free 1:1 advisory; Promising Startup Mentoring Plan; sector-agnostic

verification_notes: Borderline for this segment: Startup@Taipei is primarily a city-government startup-support platform/directory and advisory service rather than a classic cash-for-equity cohort accelerator, though it runs a mentoring/acceleration plan and hosts a 'Accelerator' directory. Founding year ~2016 (city startup office); no equity, no demo-day confirmed. Classified as government-program with accelerator subtype.
